protocol.name: geoprr_v2_original_mobile_modal_readout_v1
protocol.checkpoint_selection: minimum full-denominator source-validation NMAE, original native expectation

readouts.modal_r8: continuous expectation within the main bin peak plus/minus 8 bins, clipped at endpoints; original invalid-field fallback retained

population_accounting.pair_checks: exact sample IDs, targets and group IDs matched between readouts and across seeds

metric_definitions.error: absolute normalized full-scale error; invalid predictions retain normalized error 1.0
metric_definitions.accuracy: valid prediction with normalized error at or below 0.01, 0.02 or 0.05; full population denominator
metric_definitions.tail10: mean of the largest ceil(0.1*N) errors, failures retained
metric_definitions.quantiles: linear interpolation on the sorted full-population errors
metric_definitions.aggregation: arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation across the three seeds (n-1 denominator); no ensemble or significance test
metric_definitions.paired_rescue: native error strictly above threshold and modal_r8 error at or below threshold
metric_definitions.paired_regression: native error at or below threshold and modal_r8 error strictly above threshold

20262020.completion_evidence: 65 consecutive history rows; original run predates completed.json

execution_cost.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
execution_cost.actual_expert_selection: all source-validation and official-test rows use the field path; no learned router
execution_cost.forward_boundary: synchronized model forward plus the selected readout; excludes host-to-device transfer
execution_cost.roi_pipeline_boundary: image read, ROI crop/resize, normalization, transfer, model forward/readout and prediction collection; batched throughput
execution_cost.excluded_from_roi_pipeline: checkpoint/model construction, detector inference and CSV/summary serialization
execution_cost.timing_interpretation: observed batch-16 throughput from single runs, not single-image latency or an isolated readout-overhead benchmark; validation and test timings were collected separately

limitations: The radius was selected using seed-20262020 source validation, so those validation results include selection evidence rather than an independent confirmation set.
The official test has been viewed during historical development. Results concern its native images only and do not establish blind-test, perturbation or real-domain improvement.
All three official-test maxima worsen with modal_r8; fewer severe errors do not imply a bound on extreme errors.
Seed summaries use the same images repeatedly. The 12000 matched official-test seed pairs are not 12000 independent images, and no statistical significance claim is made.
Source-validation reevaluation and stored checkpoint-selection scores can differ slightly due to AMP/batch numeric paths; selection epochs remain unchanged.
Timing includes startup/warmup batches and excludes detection; it reports batched throughput rather than complete camera-to-reading latency.
